FormApplication /
Class FormApplication Abstract
An abstract pattern for defining an Application responsible for updating some object using
an HTML form

A few critical assumptions:

1. This application is used to only edit one object at a time
2. The template used contains one (and only one) HTML form as it's outermost element
3. This abstract layer has no knowledge of what is being updated, so the implementation

must define _updateObject
